glossary.definition: As used in this section, "major part" has the same meaning as in the "Motor Vehicle Theft Law Enforcement Act of 1984," 98 Stat. 2754, 15 U.S.C. 2021 (7), as amended.
glossary.source_title: Section 2913.82 - Towing or storage fees to be paid by person convicted of theft offense that involves motor vehicle.
